text: The applicants must fill in and provide the following documents truly, correctly and completely (in duplicates).1. Application form: The form should be duplicated in either Chinese or English.2. Highest diploma, including senior high school diploma or bachelor’s degree certificate needed in languages other than Chinese or English must be attached with notarized translations in Chinese or English.3. Academic transcripts: Transcripts in languages other than Chinese or English must be attached with notarized translations in Chinese or English.4. A study or research plan. Applicants for postgraduate degrees are required to submit a study or research plan in Chinese or in English.5. Recommendation letters: Applicants for postgraduate studies must submit two letters of recommendation in Chinese or English from professors or associate professors.Note: Application documents will not be returned regardless of the result of application
